map.χ² = Σ(O−E)²/E。 df = 类别数 − 1。: χ² = Σ(O−E)²/E. df = number of categories − 1.
map.比较观察频数与期望频数：χ²=Σ(O−E)²/E。: Compares observed frequencies with expected frequencies: χ²=Σ(O−E)²/E.
map.列联表独立性检验、分布拟合检验。: Independence tests on contingency tables and goodness-of-fit tests.
map.自由度=(行−1)(列−1) 查临界值。: df=(rows−1)(columns−1) for looking up the critical value.
map.观察 O=[60,40;30,70]（行列和均 100），期望 E=50 各格：: Observed O=[60,40;30,70] (all row and column totals 100), expected E=50 in every cell: χ²=(10²+10²+20²+20²)/50=(100+100+400+400)/50=1000/50=20. With df=1 this far exceeds the critical value 3.84, so the association is significant.
map.100 次期望 50/50，观察 60/40：χ²=(10²+10²)/50=4: 100 trials expected 50/50 and observed 60/40: χ²=(10²+10²)/50=4, df=1, p≈0.045, significant at the critical level.
map.期望频数怎么定？: How are the expected frequencies set?
map.独立性检验 E_ij=行和_i×列和_j/总计；拟合检验按理论比例分配。任一期望: For independence tests E_ij = row total_i × column total_j / grand total; for fit tests allocate by the theoretical proportions. Any expected count below 5 should be pooled or handled with Yates correction.
map.χ² 越大说明什么？: What does a larger χ² mean?
map.χ² 大表示观察与期望偏离大，越可能拒绝原假设（独立/拟合）。: A large χ² means the observed values deviate greatly from expectation, so the null hypothesis (independence or fit) is more likely to be rejected.
